VIRVENTURES

ReplyAssist

Cloud review workspace

Automatic sending and monitoring locked

Loading…

Sign in

Use the administrator password configured for this deployment.

Connection setup

This cloud instance has its own encrypted credentials and review history. Existing Windows credentials are not imported.

Connect eBay test 2
Connect Gmail

Use a Google Web application OAuth client. Add this exact authorized redirect URI:

Continue authorization

Validate connections and evidence

Checks run on Netlify after you start them. Review is capped at 10 conversations in the first 24 hours after the immutable cutoff. This is not continuous inbox monitoring.

Older conversations — manual reply
Find an older customer follow-up without changing the cutoff. Searches cover up to 24 hours and return up to 10 conversations. This does not mark messages as read. No reply is sent until you review it and approve the exact text.
Manual send history
A reserved or uncertain attempt is never retried automatically. Check eBay Sent messages before any further action. Avoid replying to the same conversation in eBay while sending here.
Review proposals
AI generation and complete order matching are not implemented. Every proposal requires manual recovery review.
Production Key Set 1 is excluded. Only individually approved older-message replies can be sent. Automated replies, emails and monitoring remain disabled.

01 / CONNECTIONS

Connect the seller and mailbox

Not verified

eBay seller access

The client ID is pinned to the new test 2 keyset. Credentials stay encrypted for this Windows user.

Complete seller sign-in and permission approval on eBay. If eBay uses its default success page, paste that page's full address below.

Seller not yet connected.

Gmail background access

The Gmail connection in a chat cannot supply credentials to this service. Use a Google Desktop app OAuth client with Gmail API enabled, then sign in as team@virventures.com.

Requests permission to send alerts and read mail to reconcile uncertain sends. No email is sent during connection checks.

Alert routing

Human review → anangsha.h@virventures.com
Post-order, in window → md.nazar@virventures.com
Post-order, outside window → no email

02 / VALIDATION & MONITORING

Review recovery safeguards

Tests pending

Read-only recovery review. Run offline tests and connection checks, establish a cutoff at the current time, then check message access. Each manual run examines at most 10 conversations in the first 24 hours after that cutoff. Full older conversation context is read, but only new messages can become proposals. No replies or emails can be sent; automatic monitoring stays off.

No processing cutoff established.

Monitoring is stopped.
Test results
No tests run yet.


03 / REVIEW LOG
Every decision, visible
Simple, explicit pre-purchase fact questions can qualify for an extractive answer when all listing text is consistent. Free-form descriptions, fitment, ambiguous intent, variants and multi-message context go to human review.
No messages processed.


Local service · Windows-encrypted credentials · No eBay.ai suggestions used as evidence
